name: priority-indicator
title: Priority indicator
description: Priority as a drawn mark and a word: urgent, high, medium, low or none, readable without colour, and optionally a menu to change it.
docs: priority is urgent, high, medium, low or none. Low, medium and high are three ascending bars with 1, 2 and 3 filled; urgent is a filled square with an exclamation mark cut out of it; none is three flat dashes. Each level has its own shape, so it reads in one colour and without colour vision, and the word is real text. size is sm (14px mark, 12px type), md (16px, 14px) or lg (20px, 16px) on one 16 unit grid. showLabel={false} keeps the mark alone, with the word in a tooltip and in the text a screen reader hears (Priority: High). editable makes it a button that opens a menu of the five levels; onPriorityChange receives the choice and the mark follows the priority you pass, so the value stays yours. labels translates the five words, label is the noun a screen reader hears first and menuLabel the menu heading. PriorityGlyph, PRIORITIES and PRIORITY_WORDS are exported from priority-indicator/glyph for a Server Component or a table cell of your own.
